text: Welcome! Take a look at my wares.
Hello, adventurer! Eris in hand, items in the inventory.
The stock changed today! Have a look.
They say giant toads have been swallowing adventurers on the plains. Especially the ones who keep screaming.
Watch out for goblins at night. And for drunk goddesses, any time.
Reputation with the merchants gives discounts, you know? Selling monster items earns our trust.
My stock changes every day. Early birds get the best items.
